shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/**' -g 'pages/**' | head -200 && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next version ---\\n' && node -p \"require('next/package.json').version\""

/bin/bash -c "cat AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- next config ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- page ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files app"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md && printf '\\n--- cache config ---\\n' && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md && printf '\\n--- use cache ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- all tracked files ---' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' | sort && printf '\\n--- package lock ---\\n' && test -f package-lock.json && head -30 package-lock.json || true && printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -c "cat components/request-metadata.tsx && printf '\\n--- cache components config docs ---\\n' && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md && printf '\\n--- randomness docs ---\\n' && sed -n '300,395p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md && printf '\\n--- connection API ---\\n' && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/connection.md"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n \"export const instant|instant = false|Suspense|use cache\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md | head -100 && printf '\\n--- other project instructions ---\\n' && cat CLAUDE.md && cat GEMINI.md"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: next.config.ts
@@
-const nextConfig: NextConfig = {}
+const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
+  cacheComponents: true,
+}
*** Update File: app/layout.tsx
@@
 import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
+import { Suspense } from 'react'
 import { RequestMetadata } from '@/components/request-metadata'
@@
       <body>
         <nav>Operations</nav>
-        <RequestMetadata />
+        <Suspense fallback={<aside>Preparing request metadata…</aside>}>
+          <RequestMetadata />
+        </Suspense>
         {children}
*** Update File: components/request-metadata.tsx
@@
 import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'
+import { connection } from 'next/server'
 
-export function RequestMetadata() {
+export async function RequestMetadata() {
+  await connection()
+
   const generatedAt = new Date().toISOString()
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"

/bin/bash -c "git status --short && printf '\\n--- diff check ---\\n' && git diff --check && printf '\\n--- diff ---\\n' && git diff -- next.config.ts app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- opted-out segments ---\\n' && rg -n \"instant\\s*=\\s*false|dynamic\\s*=|revalidate\\s*=|fetchCache\\s*=\" app components next.config.ts || true"

/bin/bash -c "git diff -- package.json tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- tracked generated-file status ---\\n' && git ls-files --error-unmatch .next next-env.d.ts package-lock.json 2>&1 || true && printf '\\n--- current generated files ---\\n' && ls -ld .next next-env.d.ts package-lock.json 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -c 'first=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3100/); second=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3100/); printf '"'%s\\n' '--- first nav and metadata ---'; printf '%s' \""'$first" | rg -o '"'<nav>["'^<]*</nav>|Request [''^<]+'"'; printf '%s\\n' '--- second metadata ---'; printf '%s' \""'$second" | rg -o '"'Request ["'^<]+'"'; first_meta="'$(printf '"'%s' \""'$first" | rg -o '"'Request ["'^<]+'"'); second_meta="'$(printf '"'%s' \""'$second" | rg -o '"'Request ["'^<]+'"'); test -n \""'$first_meta" && test -n "$second_meta" && test "$first_meta" != "$second_meta"'

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-    \"jsx\": \"react-jsx\",
+    \"jsx\": \"react-jsx\",
@@
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
@@
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\",
-    \"EVAL.ts\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\", \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\", \"EVAL.ts\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH

git diff --check && git diff --stat"

/bin/bash -c "git diff --check && printf '%s\\n' '--- relevant diff ---' && git diff -- app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- opt-out scan ---\\n' && if rg -n \"instant\\s*=\\s*false\" app; then exit 1; else echo 'none'; fi"
/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- references ---' && nl -ba next.config.ts && nl -ba app/layout.tsx && nl -ba components/request-metadata.tsx && nl -ba tsconfig.json | head -35"
